description: Run TSV fixture content against a grammar in a fresh instance, using the fleet fixture convention (@tabnas/support): line 1 is a header, the input column is escape-decoded, the expected column is JSON or ERROR / ERROR:<code>. Returns {pass, fail, rows:[{row,input,expected,got,ok}]}. Refuses more than 10000 rows.

grammar.description: Serialized GrammarSpec (pure JSON, no functions). Schema: resource tabnas://schema/grammar. Grammars are validated before use; a `ref` key or a non-builtin function reference is rejected.

expectedCol.description: Expected column, by position or header name. Default 1.

inputCol.description: Input column, by position or header name. Default 0.

name: test_grammar
